title: THIS ROOM WILL FORGET ME
subtitle: THE ROOM REMEMBERS / 01
script: Tomorrow, this room will forget me. So I hid this message inside the silence between two heartbeats. If you can hear it, the room missed one.

title: I TAUGHT IT THE WORD HOME
subtitle: THE ROOM REMEMBERS / 02
script: I taught the machine a word: home. It drew a door. Behind that door was a room. And in that room... another me.
captions: Behind that door was a room.

title: IT SHOWED ME YOUR FACE
subtitle: THE ROOM REMEMBERS / 03
script: The machine asked what I wanted to remember. I said: a face. It showed me yours. Now tell me... have we met before?
